statement.excerpt: ChatGPT has proven itself to be both unreliable and untruthful. It makes boneheaded arithmetical errors, invents fake biographical details, bungles word problems, defines non-existent scientific phenomenon, stumble over arithmetic conversion, and on and on.
statement.document_title: Scientists, please don’t let your chatbots grow up to be co-authors

our_interpretation: Assess documented behavior during the six-week history discussed in the post, through January 14, 2023.
Untruthful means producing false factual statements, without implying conscious intent to deceive.
The ordinary reading is that ChatGPT demonstrably makes these kinds of errors, not that every answer is wrong or that a particular error rate has been measured.
Treat the list as examples supporting the general reliability observation. Identify any example not independently recovered rather than silently treating it as verified.
criteria.support_condition: Independent contemporary records demonstrate arithmetic or word-problem mistakes and fabricated biographical and scientific content presented as factual.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The cited demonstrations are shown to be inauthentic, outside the target period, or factually correct, and the alleged pattern of errors and fabrications is not substantiated. Some correct answers alone do not contradict an assertion that errors occur.
